product.name: AI Character Generator
product.description: Generates AI-based photorealistic images of characters from prompts, allowing customization of facial expressions and scenes.

product.name: Real-time AI Video Generator
product.description: Produces AI-generated videos in real time from text prompts or inputs, enabling quick video content creation.

product.name: Creative Upscaler
product.description: Enhances the resolution and quality of AI-generated images or videos to improve visual detail and clarity.

product.name: Reference Person AI Stations
product.description: Provides AI-generated content based on reference persons, enabling creation of images or videos featuring specific individuals.

product.name: Anime Generator
product.description: Generates anime-style images and artwork from user prompts for creative and entertainment purposes.

product.name: Architecture Generator
product.description: Creates AI-generated architectural designs and visuals from descriptive prompts for design and visualization.
